No application form will be entertained/ accepted after the mentioned date.
All applications are subjected to a screening process constituted for the purpose. Application found incomplete in
any respect shallbe summarily rejected.
Written test will be conducted for the mentioned post if the number of Candidates in each specialization i.e at
SI.No a,b.c & d is more than 30. And if the number is less than 30 direct Walk-in-interview will be conducted.
The shortlisted candidates for the Written Test/ Walk-in-interview will be displayed in the website
www.https:/ribhoi.gov.in/dmho/.
No separate callletter or any other form of communication to be issued the candidates regarding the writen
test.
All relevant certificates, testimonials, etc to be enclosed with the application form
No TA/DA will be paid to the applicants for attending the written tes/ Interview.
In case any dispute arises, the Undersigned reserves the right to reject any or all application without assigning any
reason thereof.
ID card (EPIC, AADHAR, Driving Licence etc.) must be produced at the time of the Written Test., failing which
the candidates will not be allowed to sit for the test.
